utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks for the update — Sunday at the community center it is, then. I’ll let folks know to head there instead.

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you confirm the drop-off spot is the community center too, and is 9 the start time?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, the community center is the drop-off spot too, and 9 is the start time. Thanks for checking — I’m a little fuzzy on the details sometimes.

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be fantastic, Ira—thanks so much. Just let folks know it’s this Saturday at the front porch, and I’m still figuring out exactly what’s needed.

utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Gus—that’ll help a lot. I’ll let folks know you’ve got wrenches and screwdrivers to lend at the porch.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, thanks—I’m counting on that help this Saturday at the front porch. I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive.

utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Uli — the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center now. Please drop things off there, and if you have any spare tools or extension cords, that would be great.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll spread the word and see if I can bring any tools or cords by Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — I really appreciate you spreading the word and helping out. See you Sunday at the community center!

utterances.text: Noah: Oh yeah, the repair drive this Saturday at the community center — I can spread the word. Let me know if you still need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Nell
